### Setup from setup.R/renv.lock
```{r}
source("setup.R")
```

### Download BRFSS
```{r}
download_brfss(2024)
```

### Read BRFSS
```{r}
ingest_brfss_to_duckdb(2024)
```
### Establish Connection to duckDB
```{r}
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(shared_home = FALSE),
  dbdir = "data/brfss.duckdb",
  read_only = TRUE
)

DBI::dbListTables(con)
```

### Exploratory
```{r}
# Dimensions
DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows
  FROM brfss_2024
  "
)

ncol(DBI::dbListFields(con, "brfss_2024"))

# Preview
DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT * FROM brfss_2024 LIMIT 5"
)
```

```{r}
brfss <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "
  SELECT
    -- -----------------------
    -- Survey / time
    -- -----------------------
    SEQNO,
    _STATE,
    FMONTH,
    IDATE,
    IMONTH,
    IDAY,
    IYEAR,

    -- -----------------------
    -- Demographics
    -- -----------------------
    SEXVAR,
    _AGEG5YR,
    _AGE65YR,
    _AGE80,
    _RACE,
    _RACEGR3,
    INCOME3,

    -- -----------------------
    -- Healthcare access
    -- -----------------------
    PRIMINS2,
    _HLTHPL2,
    PERSDOC3,
    MEDCOST1,
    CHECKUP1,

    -- -----------------------
    -- Mental / physical health
    -- -----------------------
    GENHLTH,
    PHYSHLTH,
    _PHYS14D,
    MENTHLTH,
    _MENT14D,

    -- -----------------------
    -- Other useful context
    -- -----------------------
    EXERANY2,
    _TOTINDA,

    -- -----------------------
    -- Survey weighting vars
    -- Keep even if not used yet
    -- -----------------------
    _PSU,
    _STSTR,
    _LLCPWT

  FROM brfss_2024
  "
) |>
  tibble::as_tibble()
```
